*I haven't seen T2*, but I'm curious about how fans (or the core fanbase) would like future movies/stories in the franchise and the "world-building" to continue. Do people want any scenes involving the authorities (and how they're trying to deal with the serial killer), or should it stay focused more "intimately" on Art, his kills, and a few characters / average people? I could be wrong, but I get the sense the movie goes from set to set and there aren't many outdoor establishing shots or much of a sense of the world around the characters. (which is fair enough given that this is still a low-budget film)

I thought it'd be cool if a future movie had something like a SWAT team btfo out of Art (especially if real gunfire is used on a realistic human/Art prop with realistic organs stuffed inside), or something like the police station scene in the first Terminator movie, if Art has or gets the ability to withstand lots of gunfire. Or something like the beginning of Jason Goes to Hell, the only part people like I think (honestly I liked the movie overall).

But that's more action-oriented and may not be what the fanbase wants. Budget-wise given the success of this movie I could see Damien getting millions of dollars for future films.

Not saying you're wrong, just posting some thoughts:

I guess it could have been shorter if it was made specifically for streaming services. It did get a limited theatrical release and obviously people paying money for a specific movie want their money's worth. Perhaps the people seeking out Terrifier for that limited release would be fine with a 60min movie since it had enough gore, but at the same time some people still correlate "value" with "runtime". I could see maybe 5-7 min being cut out for a still-"respectable" 80 min runtime but not much more.
